competencies.name: Pressure flow and resistance
competencies.can: Apply the relationship among flow, pressure gradient, and resistance and predict the effect of a change in vessel radius, blood viscosity, or vessel length on flow.

competencies.name: Vessel structure and function
competencies.can: Match arteries, arterioles, capillaries, venules, and veins to their role in pressure buffering, resistance, exchange, and capacitance.

competencies.name: Arterial blood pressure
competencies.can: Define systolic, diastolic, pulse, and mean arterial pressure, calculate mean arterial pressure, and explain how it is determined by cardiac output and total peripheral resistance.

competencies.name: Local control of blood flow
competencies.can: Explain myogenic, metabolic, and endothelial control of arteriolar tone and predict the local flow response to increased tissue metabolism.

competencies.name: Capillary exchange and Starling forces
competencies.can: Identify the four Starling forces at a capillary and determine the net direction of fluid movement at the arterial and venous ends.

competencies.name: Edema
competencies.can: Explain how increased capillary hydrostatic pressure, reduced plasma protein, increased permeability, or lymphatic blockage each produce edema and match a clinical scenario to its mechanism.

competencies.name: Lymphatic return
competencies.can: State the volume of fluid the lymphatic system returns each day and trace lymph from an interstitial space to the subclavian vein.

competencies.name: Venous return
competencies.can: Explain the skeletal muscle pump, the respiratory pump, and venoconstriction and predict the effect of prolonged standing on venous return and stroke volume.

competencies.name: Blood pressure measurement
competencies.can: Measure blood pressure by auscultation, explain the origin of the Korotkoff sounds, and record the response to a postural or exercise challenge.
